title: opentine.forge-claim (claim_version 1)
description: An upstream's claim of its project (SPEC 4.19): the unsigned file `.opentine/project` on the default branch. `fingerprint` is sha256 of `opentine.forge-claim.v1:` + the digest of the project's first manifest version. A verifier reports a match as `claimed by upstream (as mirrored)`, never a pass.
